team.sub: People shown on the About page, in this order.
team.emptyText: Add the first person. They stay hidden until shown.
team.confirmDelete: Delete {name}? Their photo is removed too if nothing else uses it. This can’t be undone.
team.photoHint: Optional. Without a photo a monogram is shown.

series.title: Series
series.sub: Chapters and the characters who tell them. Models, colors and camera stay in code.
series.unstoredNote: Rows marked “built-in” have never been edited. Reordering or editing them stores them in the database.
series.chaptersSub: Chapter words and titles in both languages.
series.chaptersNote: Chapters are driven by the scene in code, so they cannot be hidden here. You can edit their words and titles and change their order.
series.charactersNote: Switch voices on or off and set their order. A hidden voice disappears everywhere on the site: the home eyes and reel, the lantern wall, the series switcher, cast list, 3D stage and narration. Models, camera and motion stay in code.

voices.count: {count, plural, =0 {No voices are shown on the site} one {1 voice is shown on the site} other {# voices are shown on the site}}
voices.zero: No voice is switched on. The home eyes and reel sections are hidden and the series page shows an empty state.
voices.one: Only one voice is on. The switcher and the cast list are hidden and the headline reads “One voice”.
voices.order: Order saved here sets the order on the site.
voices.previewFor: Preview the series page (opens in a new tab)

look.title: Look
look.hint: Portrait, accent color and stage tint. Empty means the built-in look.

look.focusHint: Click the image to choose which part stays in view when it is cropped.
look.focusPicker: Portrait preview. Click to set the focus point.
look.accentHint: Tints the light, rim and dots for this voice.
look.stageHint: Background tint of the stage while this voice tells the story.

series.charactersSub: Names, roles, moods and narration lines.
series.wordHint: The large faint word behind the hero.
series.narrationHint: One line per chapter. Leave a line empty to keep the built-in text, shown here as the placeholder.
